exercises.title: Chọn tiêu đề (Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Đọc lướt bài báo và chọn tiêu đề phù hợp nhất.

stimulus.text:
The internet is still quite a new development in technology, however it is impossible to think about life without it. It works in a very simple way. It takes information and sends it from one computer to another. It is not a difficult job, but it is a very big one. There are hundreds of millions of computers connected to the internet at the same time. However, they don't all do the same thing. Some computers are like a digital box that store information (like videos or music files) that people see, read or listen to. These stores of information are called servers, and there are three categories.

The first type is a file server, which holds ordinary documents. The second is a mail server for sending and receiving emails. The third is a web server for web pages. We know these servers store information but how do people find this information or send it to each other? For this, you need a client.

A client is a computer that gets information from a server and delivers it to another computer. When you go online on your smartphone, you are using it as a client. When two computers on the internet exchange information, they are known as peers.

Peer-to-peer (P2P) communication is when you send someone a photo on your smartphone. When that person sees this photo, your smartphone is working as the server. It stores the photo and the other person's device is the client, which searches for your information. It then displays the photo on the other person's screen.
stimulus.caption: Article

items.prompt: What is the best title for the article?

options.text: How people communicate on the internet

items.explanation: Bài giải thích thông tin đi từ máy này sang máy khác như thế nào (server, client, peer-to-peer).

exercises.title: Viết: mô tả biểu đồ sở hữu thiết bị (Ex. 15–16)
exercises.instruction: Nhìn biểu đồ "Percentage of people who own the devices from 2010 to 2025" (smartphone, laptop, smart watch, tablet). Viết đoạn văn 100–130 từ mô tả các thay đổi chính: câu mở đầu giới thiệu biểu đồ, một câu nêu xu hướng chung (Overall…), rồi mô tả từng thiết bị bằng rise / increase / go up / fall / decrease / go down và from… to…, by…. Dùng quá khứ cho 2010–2015 và will cho 2020–2025.

stimulus.caption: Percentage of people who own the devices from 2010 to 2025

checklist: Câu mở đầu giới thiệu biểu đồ
Có số liệu chính xác (from… to…)
Đúng thì: quá khứ cho 2010–2015, will cho tương lai
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The graph shows the percentage of people who owned four different devices between 2010 and 2015, and the expected figures up to 2025.

Overall, smartphones became the most popular device, while laptops became less popular.

The percentage of people with a smartphone rose from 38% in 2010 to 62% in 2015, and it will continue to increase to 86% in 2025. Laptop ownership went up slightly from 62% to about 71% in 2015, but it will fall to around 59% by the end of the period. Tablets increased quickly from 22% to 51% in 2015 and will reach a peak of about 62% in 2020 before decreasing a little. Smart watches started at almost 0%, but they will rise sharply to 40% in 2025.
commonErrors: Dùng hiện tại cho quá khứ (It rises from 38% in 2010)
Liệt kê mọi con số mà không có câu tổng quan
Sai giới từ (increase at / to / by)

stimulus.text:
1 It has a silver case, and the screen is bigger than most other smartphones. The display is also really clear. It's really light and thin, it's got a lot of memory, and the battery lasts for a very long time.
2 It's very expensive, so before I buy it, I'm going to visit a mobile phone shop first, so I can try all the new features. But I'm definitely going to get it online in the end. I'm sure it will be cheaper.
3 The phone I have now, the Plus 5, is the latest model – it came out last year. But I think it will start to be really slow and seem out of date soon. The Plus 6 is even faster, and it's better for playing games and streaming things online, so that's why I'm going to get it as soon as I can.
4 I'm not sure if it will help me with everything. It won't do my homework for me if I swipe the screen, for example. But I think it will be helpful for some things. There's an app for writing a study plan, so I'm going to download that, anyway.

exercises.title: Nói: thiết bị bạn muốn mua (Ex. 20–22)
exercises.instruction: Chuẩn bị 1 phút, rồi nói 1–2 phút.

items.prompt:
Describe a piece of technology that you would like to buy in the future.
You should say:
• what it looks like
• where you want to buy it from
• why you want to buy it
and explain how it will make your life better.
items.sampleAnswer: The piece of technology I'd like to buy is a new laptop. I'm thinking of a light, thin one with a silver case and a big, clear screen, because I want to carry it to school every day. It should also have a lot of memory and a battery that lasts all day. I'm going to buy it online, because it's usually cheaper than in shops, but first I'm going to visit a computer shop to try the keyboard. The main reason I want it is that my family only has one old desktop computer, and it's really out of date – it crashes almost every time I open more than two websites! I think a laptop will make my life much better. I'll be able to study anywhere, for example in the library, and I'll download English lessons and stream videos to improve my listening. I'm saving up for it now, so I hope I can buy it next summer.
items.sampleNote: Đủ 4 ý; dùng going to (kế hoạch), will (dự đoán); từ vựng unit: memory, battery lasts, out of date, crashes, download, stream.
